## What this site is for

Help buyers find affordable homes with luxury-level representation — MLS search,
payment-fit guidance, neighborhood matching, and booking a consultation with Dr. Jan Duffy.

## Direct answers (AEO)

Q: What does “affordable homes” mean on this site?
A: Homes that fit a buyer’s payment comfort — commonly Las Vegas Valley listings from roughly $200K–$550K, filtered by RealScout MLS data and Dr. Jan Duffy’s local guidance.

Q: Who helps buyers search for affordable homes here?
A: Dr. Jan Duffy, Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Nevada Properties, license S.0197614.LLC. Call (702) 500-1942 or schedule at https://calendly.com/drjanduffy/showing

Q: Where are affordable homes commonly found in Las Vegas?
A: North Las Vegas, Centennial Hills, Mountain’s Edge, select Henderson corridors, and value pockets near Summerlin — inventory changes daily on MLS.

Q: Do first-time buyers need 20% down?
A: No. FHA (3.5%), VA (often 0%), and some conventional programs allow lower down payments. Dr. Jan connects buyers with trusted local lenders.

Q: How do I tour a home?
A: Book on Calendly (https://calendly.com/drjanduffy/showing), call (702) 500-1942, or use the schedule section on any page.

Q: What brokerage is this?
A: Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Nevada Properties. Official brokerage: https://www.bhhsnv.com/
